Rashi on Shabbat 6b:10:1.english: In the days of summer - When there are no crops in it.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:10:2.hebrew: רה"י לשבת - דהא לאו הילוך לרבים הוא, שאין רבים מסתלקין מן המסילה לילך בשדה:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:10:2.english: [A] private domain for Shabbat - For this is not a thoroughfare for the public, as the public does not turn aside from the road to walk in the field.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:10:3.hebrew: רה"ר לטומאה - וספקו טהור, דהא לאו מקום סתירה הוא, שיש בני אדם נכנסים לה. דספק טומאה לטמא מסוטה גמרינן לה, והתם סתירה כתיב: "ונסתרה והיא נטמאה", דבמקום סתירה טמאה היא לבעלה מספק, ומכאן אתה דן לשרץ:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:10:3.english: A public domain with regard to ritual impurity - And [a case of] doubt concerning it is [ruled] pure, for this is not a place of seclusion, as people enter it. For [the principle that] a doubt regarding ritual impurity is deemed impure we derive from [the case of a] sotah [a woman suspected of adultery], and there seclusion is written: "And she was secluded and defiled" (Numbers 5:13) — for in a place of seclusion she is [rendered] defiled to her husband out of doubt, and from here you derive [the rule for] a creeping animal.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:10:4.hebrew: בימות הגשמים - שהיא זרועה, אין אדם נכנס לה:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:10:4.english: In the rainy season - Since it is sown, no person enters it.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:11:1.english: Actually, it is a karmelit - And one who throws from the public domain into it is not liable.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:1:1.hebrew: לחי מכאן ולחי מכאן - בשתי פאות של אחד מן הבתים, להיכר בעלמא — דקסבר רבי יהודה: ב' מחיצות הוו רה"י מדאורייתא, והא איכא שתי מחיצות מעלייתא — מחיצות של ב' בתים:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:1:1.english: A sidepost from here and a sidepost from there - At the two corners of one of the houses, merely as a recognizable marker; for Rabbi Yehuda holds that two partitions constitute a private domain by Torah law, and behold, there are two proper partitions — the walls of the two houses.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:2:1.hebrew: מהו דתימא כי פליגי רבנן עליה דר' יהודה - בברייתא, ואמרי אין מערבין רה"ר בכך למהוי רה"י — ה"מ לטלטל, שיהא מותר לטלטל בתוכה, כדקתני אין מערבין רה"ר בכך, דגזור בה משום דדמי לרה"ר:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:2:1.english: Lest you say: When the Rabbis disagree with Rabbi Yehuda - In the baraita, and say, "One may not make an eiruv for a public domain in this manner" so as to become a private domain — this applies [only] to carrying, [namely] that it should be permitted to carry within it, as it teaches: "One may not make an eiruv for a public domain in this manner," for they decreed concerning it because it resembles a public domain.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:2:2.hebrew: אבל לזרוק - שהזורק מרה"ר לתוכה, מודו ליה דחייב — דשתי מחיצות דאוריי', ושם רה"י עליה:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:2:2.english: However, [with regard] to throwing - That [regarding] one who throws from the public domain into it, they agree with him that he is liable, for two partitions are [sufficient by] Torah law, and the status of a private domain is upon it.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:2:3.hebrew: קמ"ל - גמורה, כלומר: זו היא שנגמרו מניין מחיצות שלה, שיש לה מחיצות מכל צד, כגון חריץ; וכן גדר, דאמרינן מד' צדדין: "גוד אסיק פני המחיצה על ראשו", ונמצא ראשו מוקף מד' צדדין וחללו ד'. אבל דרבי יהודה — לא נגמרו מחיצות שלה למניינן, ולאו רה"י היא כלל:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:2:3.english: It teaches us - [The word] "full-fledged" — that is to say: This is [a domain] whose count of partitions is complete, in that it has partitions on all sides, such as a ditch; and likewise a fence, for we say on four sides: "Extend and raise the face of the partition onto its top," and [thus] its top is found to be enclosed on four sides and its interior [space] is four [handbreadths]. However, [in the case] of Rabbi Yehuda, its partitions have not reached their [requisite] count, and it is not a private domain at all.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:3:1.hebrew: מפסקתן - לפסי ביראות בפרק ב' דעירובין, דהקילו חכמים משום עולי רגלים בבור בר"ה — והבור עצמה רה"י, שהיא עמוקה י' ורחבה ד', והממלא מתוכה ומניח על שפתה חייב — והקילו חכמים לעשות ד' פסין וביניהן י' אמות, דהוי חללו רה"י למלאות מן הבור. וקאמר ר' יהודה: אם היתה דרך רה"ר מפסקתן, יסלקנה מביניהן, דאתו רבים ומבטלי מחיצתה. והתם רמינן דרבי יהודה אדרבי יהודה דלעיל, דאמר: נושא ונותן באמצע, דלא אתו רבים ומבטלין מחיצות; ורבנן אדרבנן; ומשנינן לה:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:3:1.english: Interrupts them - [This refers] to the posts around cisterns in the second chapter of Eruvin, where the Sages were lenient for the sake of the festival pilgrims regarding a cistern in a public domain — for the cistern itself is a private domain, being ten [handbreadths] deep and four [handbreadths] wide, and one who draws [water] from within it and places [it] upon its rim is liable — and the Sages were lenient [by permitting them] to erect four posts with [up to] ten cubits between them, so that its interior space becomes a private domain [in order] to draw [water] from the cistern. And Rabbi Yehuda says: If a path of the public domain interrupts them, he must divert it from between them, for the multitudes come and negate its partition. And there [in Eruvin 22a], we raised a contradiction between Rabbi Yehuda and Rabbi Yehuda above, who said: "One may carry and place [objects] in the middle," [showing] that the multitudes do not come and negate partitions; and [likewise between] the Rabbis and the Rabbis; and we resolved it.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:3:2.hebrew: אינו צריך - והיינו דקתני: זו היא רה"ר — אבל הילוך דרבים לבין הפסים לא הוי רה"ר, הואיל ואיכא שם ד' מחיצות:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:3:2.english: He need not - And that is what was taught: "This is the public domain" — but the passage of the multitudes between the posts does not become a public domain, since there are four partitions there.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:4:1.hebrew: ומאי גמורה - הכא ליכא למימר "מהו דתימא" כדלעיל, דעיקר עשייתן משום לטלטל בתוכו, וקאמרי רבנן: "אינו צריך" — דרשות היחיד היא אפילו לטלטל, וכ"ש דהזורק לתוכה מרה"ר חייב:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:4:1.english: And why [is it called] "full-fledged" - Here, one cannot say "Lest you say..." as above, for the primary purpose of making them was in order to carry within it, and the Rabbis say: "He need not [divert it]" — for it is a private domain even [such that one is permitted] to carry [within it], and all the more so that one who throws into it from the public domain is liable.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:5:1.english: At the time when Israel was in the desert - It was considered a public domain.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:5:2.hebrew: בזמן הזה - אינו מקום הילוך לרבים, דהולכי מדברות לא שכיחי:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:5:2.english: In the present time - It is not a place of passage for the public, as desert travelers are not common.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:6:1.hebrew: חייב חטאת פשיטא - כיון דתנא חדא רה"י וחדא רה"ר, ניתני סתמא: "ואם הוציא והכניס חייב", ואנא ידענא דשגגתו חטאת, דהא שבת זדונו כרת הוא:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:6:1.english: [He is] liable to a sin-offering — it is obvious - Since [the tanna] taught [that] one is a private domain and one is a public domain, let him teach simply: "And if he carried out or brought in, he is liable," and I would know that its unwitting [violation requires] a sin-offering, for [with regard to] Shabbat, its intentional [violation incurs] karet.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:7:1.english: This too is obvious - For [that] with forewarning [the penalty is] stoning [is derived] from [the case of] the wood-gatherer.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:7:2.hebrew: מגילת סתרים - שהסתירוה מפני שלא ניתנה ליכתוב. וכששומעין דברי יחיד חדשים, שאינן נשנין בב"ה, וכותבין אותן שלא ישתכחו — מסתירין את המגילה:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:7:2.english: A hidden scroll - For they concealed it, because [the Oral Torah] was not permitted to be written down. And when they heard novel teachings of an individual that were not taught in the study hall, and wrote them down so that they would not be forgotten, they would conceal the scroll.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:7:3.hebrew: אינו חייב אלא אחת - השתא משמע: אם עשאן בהעלם אחד — שלא נודע לו בין כל אחת ואחת שחטא — אינו חייב אלא אחת, דכל חילול דשבת גוף אחד של עבירה הוא:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:7:3.english: He is liable for only one - At this stage, it implies that if he performed them in a single lapse of awareness — without it becoming known to him between each and every one that he had sinned — he is liable for only one [sin-offering], for all desecration of Shabbat is a single entity of transgression.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:8:1.hebrew: מנינא למה לי - ליתני אבות מלאכות הזורע והחורש כו'. למה לי לאשמעי' מניינא? הא מני להו ואזיל:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:8:1.english: Why do I need the tally - Let [the Mishnah] teach: "The primary categories of labor [are] sowing and plowing, etc." Why do I need [it] to inform us of the tally? Behold, it proceeds to enumerate them.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:8:2.hebrew: חייב על כל אחת ואחת - ובא להודיענו סכום החטאות שאדם חייב באיסורי שבת בהעלם אחד. ואשמעינן: מ' חסר אחת הן, ותו לא — שאפי' עשה תולדותיהן עמהן, אינו מביא על התולדה היכא דעשאה עם אביה, דה"ל כעושה וחוזר ועושה, דכול' חדא עבירה היא:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:8:2.english: [He is] liable for each and every one - And [the tally] comes to inform us of the total number of sin-offerings that a person is liable for regarding the prohibitions of Shabbat in a single lapse of awareness, and it teaches us that they are forty-less-one and no more; for even if he performed their subcategories along with them, he does not bring [a sin-offering] for the subcategory where he performed it with its primary category, for it is considered like one who performs and repeatedly performs [the same labor], as it is all one transgression.

Rashi on Shabbat 6b:9:1.hebrew: אינו חייב על אחת מהן - אחת יש בהן שאינו חייב עליה מיתה, ולא פי' (רבי) איזו היא. ואשמעי' תנא דמתנית' דקתני נסקל, דהא הוצאה והכנסה מהנך דלא מספקן היא, דעל זו לא אמר איסי בן יהודה:
Rashi on Shabbat 6b:9:1.english: He is not liable for one of them - There is one among them for which one is not liable to the death penalty, and he did not specify which one it is. And the tanna of the baraita, who taught "[he is] stoned," teaches us that this [labor of] carrying out and bringing in is among those [labors] about which there is no doubt, for Isi ben Yehuda did not say [his statement] regarding this one.

Tosafot on Shabbat 6b:2:1.hebrew: ואמאי קרי ליה גמורה כו' מהו דתימא - אומר ר"י, דלשון "גמורה" — אדרבה, איפכא מסתברא: "זו היא רה"י גמורה" — אבל זו אינה רה"י גמורה, אבל היא רה"י קצת. ורש"י ישבה בדוחק לפי הגמרא:
Tosafot on Shabbat 6b:2:1.english: "And why did they call it 'full-fledged'? etc. Lest you say" - The Ri says that regarding the wording "full-fledged," on the contrary, the opposite seems logical: "This is a full-fledged private domain" — but that [other one] is not a full-fledged private domain, yet it is somewhat of a private domain. And Rashi resolved it with difficulty, according to the Gemara.

Tosafot on Shabbat 6b:5:1.hebrew: כאן בזמן שישראל שרויין במדבר - משמע קצת, דאינה ר"ה, אלא א"כ מצויין שם ששים רבוא, כמו במדבר:
Tosafot on Shabbat 6b:5:1.english: "Here, at the time when Israel was dwelling in the desert" - This implies somewhat that [an area] is not a public domain unless sixty myriad [600,000 people] are present there, as in the desert.

Tosafot on Shabbat 6b:6:1.hebrew: בשוגג חייב חטאת פשיטא - כיון דאשמעינן דהאי הוי רה"י והאי הוי ר"ה, פשיטא דהמוציא מזה לזה בשוגג חייב חטאת:
Tosafot on Shabbat 6b:6:1.english: "[If he did so] unwittingly, he is liable [to bring] a sin-offering — [this is] obvious" - Since [the Baraita] has taught us that this is a private domain and that is a public domain, it is obvious that one who carries out from this [domain] to that [domain] unwittingly is liable [to bring] a sin-offering.

Tosafot on Shabbat 6b:7:1.hebrew: הא קמ"ל כרב כו' - מכאן מדקדק ר"י, דלא קתני איסי "אינו חייב על אחת מהן" אלא אסקילה, אבל חטאת — חייב על כולם; דאי קאי אחטאת — א"כ, כי פריך: "בשוגג חייב חטאת — פשיטא!", הו"ל לשנויי: "הא קמ"ל כרב", דהא דמשני: "במזיד ענוש כרת ונסקל איצטריכא ליה" — לא משני מידי! ומעיקרא ודאי לא היה ידע דמיירי בסקילה, מדפריך מדר' יוחנן דמיירי בחטאת, והיינו משום ד"אינו חייב אלא אחת" לא מצי לאוקמי בסקילה — דאטו בתרי קטלי קטלינן ליה?! אבל כי קמפרש ד"אינו חייב על אחת מהן" קאמר איסי, אז ידע שפיר דלא איירי איסי אלא בסקילה, דלא פליג אמתני' דכלל גדול (לקמן שבת עג:), דקתני מניינא למימר דחייב על כל אחת ואחת. ואתי שפיר הא דבריש פרק כלל גדול (שבת סט.) קאמר ארבי יוחנן, דאמר שאם עשאן כולם בהעלם אחת חייב כו': "דידע לה לשבת במאי?", ומפרש: "דידע לה לתחומים, ואליבא דר"ע" — ולא מצי למימר דידע לה בדאיסי, דהא אכולהו חייב חטאת; וכן פירש בקונטרס. ולקמן בריש הזורק (שבת דף צו:) מייתי לדאיסי לענין סקילה, ולא מישתמיט בשום מקום לאתויי לענין חטאת. והא דאמרינן לקמן בריש פרק בתרא (שבת דף קנד.) לרמי בר חמא: "דילמא הכי קאמר: כל שחייבין על שגגתו חטאת חייבים על זדונו סקילה" — אומר ריב"א, דאליבא דרמי בר חמא אתיא ההיא ברייתא דלא כאיסי, דלאיסי איכא דוכתא דחייב חטאת ולא סקילה:
Tosafot on Shabbat 6b:7:1.english: This comes to teach us in accordance with Rav, etc. - From here, the Ri deduces that Isi taught "he is not liable for one of them" only regarding stoning, but regarding a sin-offering, he is liable for all of them. For if [Isi's statement] referred to a sin-offering, if so, when [the Gemara] objected: "[If] unwittingly, he is liable to a sin-offering — it is obvious!", it should have answered: "This comes to teach us in accordance with Rav." For that which it answered: "It was necessary [to teach that if] intentionally, he is punishable by karet and stoned" — does not answer anything! And initially, [the Gemara] certainly did not know that [Isi] was dealing with stoning, as it objected from Rabbi Yoḥanan, which deals with a sin-offering; and this is because "he is liable only for one" cannot be established regarding stoning — for would we execute him with two executions?! However, once it explains that Isi meant "he is not liable for one of them," it then knew well that Isi was speaking only of stoning, so that he does not disagree with the Mishnah of Klal Gadol (below, Shabbat 73b), which teaches the tally [of thirty-nine labors] to say that one is liable for each and every one. And this settles well that which at the beginning of chapter Klal Gadol (Shabbat 69a), [the Gemara] asks concerning Rabbi Yoḥanan — who said that if he performed all of them in one lapse of awareness, he is liable [for each one], etc.: "In what [prohibition] did he know of Shabbat?" And it explains: "That he knew of it regarding [the prohibition of Shabbat] boundaries (techumin), and according to Rabbi Akiva." And [the Gemara] could not say that he knew of it regarding that [labor] of Isi, because for all of them one is liable to a sin-offering; and so the Kuntres explained. And below, at the beginning of HaZorek (Shabbat 96b), [the Gemara] cites [the statement of] Isi regarding stoning, and it nowhere happens to cite it regarding a sin-offering. And as for that which we say below at the beginning of the last chapter (Shabbat 154a) to Rami bar Ḥama: "Perhaps this is what it means: Whatever [labor] one is liable to a sin-offering for its unwitting violation, one is liable to stoning for its intentional violation" — Riva says that according to Rami bar Ḥama, that baraita follows [a view that is] not in accordance with Isi, for according to Isi there is a case where one is liable to a sin-offering but not to stoning.

Tosafot on Shabbat 6b:8:1.hebrew: ואמר רבי יוחנן שאם עשאן כולם בהעלם אחת כו' - אין צריך לפרש דפריך דמסתמא לא פליג איסי עלה, אלא מדברי איסי נמי יש לדקדק כן, מדקתני מניינא, כדדייק לקמן בכלל גדול (שבת דף עג:):
Tosafot on Shabbat 6b:8:1.english: "And Rabbi Yoḥanan said: That if he performed all of them in one lapse of awareness, etc." - It is not necessary to explain that [the Gemara] is objecting [on the grounds] that Isi presumably does not dispute it; rather, from the words of Isi [himself] this may also be deduced, since he taught the tally, just as [the Gemara] deduces below in Kelal Gadol (Shabbat 73b).
